Name: Sweet Gem Regrow
Author: proudunicorn
Description:
1.0.3 adds a compatibility fix for Better Crops and Foraging. Your sweet gems should not look like cauliflowers now! Thank you to TerraCipher for testing :)


NOTE: GIANT CAULIFLOWERS WILL LOOK WEIRD! I did not realise this when I made the mod. At the moment I do not know how to fix this. It does not change how the giant cauliflowers work, it just makes them look strange!

Exactly what it says. Sweet Gem Crops will regrow.

The number of days it takes to regrow is configurable.
Default config:
﻿"Regrow_Days": "21"
I chose 21 for balance.

Inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6557]Starfruits Will Regrow[/url] by DeathTheClover, and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4685]More Crops Regrow[/url] by strobel1ght.

Should work with all languages - although the config is in English.

Asset is just an edited combo of two vanilla sprites - edited by me.

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4130]Farming made easy[/url] regrow settings will override this mod, so if you are using Farming Made Easy, you don't need this mod. Thank you to sparkyone12 for testing this and mentioning it in the comments!

Downloads.Description: Added a soft dependency (not required) to fix visual glitch with Better Crops and Foraging.
